verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the probe confirming an official CLI, PowerShell, documented for scripting. That implies scriptable automation, but nothing in the pack shows Windows running headlessly or in CI pipelines. The Windows Server 2019 compile anecdote (windows-comm-10) is tangential and not cited. Missing for 10: evidence of headless operation (e.g. a GUI-less install mode), documented CI runner or pipeline usage, unattended or non-interactive setup docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
